Geographies Served Programs Bharat Yoga Vidya Kendra District Chittoor State Andhra Pradesh District Chittoor States Andhra Pradesh Bharat Yoga Vidya Kendra imparts authentic, traditional Yoga for holistic well-being. Under the direct guidance of Sri M, who has practised Yoga since childhood and taught its deeper aspects, the Kendra follows a curriculum based on ancient yogic texts like Yoga Sutras of Patanjali and Haṭha Yoga Pradīpikā. Operating in Madanapalle, Andhra Pradesh, BYVK conducts free community Yoga classes, provides awareness sessions, and trains Satsang Vidyalaya students. Recognized by the Government of India and the Ministry of AYUSH, BYVK offers regular Yoga classes and programmes, fostering a deeper understanding of traditional scriptures and practices. Swaasthya Hospital District Annamayya State Andhra Pradesh District Annamayya States Andhra Pradesh Swaasthya is a 50-bed, secondary care hospital in Madanapalle was established by TSF in 2023 and has been providing emergency and critical care for free to anyone in need. The hospital also conducts outreach camps with trained medical representatives traveling to locations in and around Madanapalle to conduct screenings, preliminary diagnostics and create awareness about prevailing illnesses in the area and safety precautions to be taken. Education Programmes District Chittoor Ghaziabad State Andhra Pradesh Uttar Pradesh District Chittoor Ghaziabad States Andhra Pradesh Uttar Pradesh Educational programs at Satsang Vidyalaya encompass free, high-quality, multi-lingual education for low-income communities in Madanapalle, Andhra Pradesh. Founded by Sri M in 1999, the school has grown from a thatched hut to an institution with 200+ students enrolled annually (Classes I–X), offering an English medium education. Similarly, Chanda Satsang Vidyalaya in Lathira, Uttar Pradesh, established in 2017, provides free education, learning materials, medical care, and nutritious meals for 130+ students annually in a pastoral setting. Peepal Grove School, inaugurated in 2006, offers alternative education with a vision of fostering critical thinking and cultural celebration. Satsang Seva Mission District New Delhi Hyderabad Chittoor Nagpur Pune Mathura Annamayya Coimbatore Mumbai Chennai Bengaluru State Andhra Pradesh Karnataka Tamil Nadu Delhi Maharashtra Uttar Pradesh Telangana District New Delhi Hyderabad Chittoor Nagpur Pune Mathura Annamayya Coimbatore Mumbai Chennai Bengaluru States Andhra Pradesh Karnataka Tamil Nadu Delhi Maharashtra Uttar Pradesh Telangana The Satsang Seva Mission was created during the earliest weeks of the COVID-19 pandemic to meet the immediate and emergency needs of the dispossessed, the less privileged, and frontline workers. The initiative has evolved over time, and it now hosts langars and annadaanam seva in various cities in India. Feeding the needy, through cooked meals and monthly rations at orphanages, hospitals, old age homes, and in disaster-hit areas, are a key focus of the mission. More than 2.3 million meals have been served through its Annadaanam centres in Mathura-Vrindavan and Madanapalle, A.P., dry ration distribution drives were conducted in flood affected areas of UP and Uttarakhand, Yoga camps were conducted for prisons inmates, in shelter homes and orphanages across the country with result that over 831,215 lives have been touched till date.
